description: Personal-detail screening policy shared by lib.py, convex/lib/agentIntake.ts and pow-cli. Every string value and every undeclared object key of an outgoing record is screened for phone numbers, email addresses and honorific-led names, whatever its schema says. A value shaped as a hex hash (40 or 64 hex digits, optionally prefixed sha256:) is refused unless its path is one of the designated hash fields below, since a hash of a personal detail is itself a pseudonymous personal detail. Paths join object keys with dots and write every array index as []. Each field listed here was audited as a digest the pipeline computes, never text a model writes.
